name: @skynet-initiative/sky-remote-workspace
description: Public source for the sky-remote browser artefacts: the in-page SDK, the consent surface and the mirror rebuilder. Only the SDK is published to npm; it carries the version, and `npm version` in that directory is what moves it. The engine, control plane and deployment configuration are in the private Skynet-Initiative/sky-remote repository.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run publish-check && npm run reproducible
